overview: This one-page file consists solely of a “List of Papers” describing an August 29, 1941 communication from Brunner at Taihoku concerning the North Formosa Peace Memorial Association. The listed item was a signed copy of the minutes of the association’s board meeting, held on August 26, 1941, at the Twututia Foreign Club in Taihoku, Taiwan, then under Japanese rule; the minutes themselves are not present in the supplied text.

people.name: Brunner
people.role: Sender at Taihoku; position not stated

subfiles.title: List of Papers: North Formosa Peace Memorial Association
subfiles.about: A file index records the transmission of signed minutes from an August 26, 1941 meeting of the North Formosa Peace Memorial Association’s board.
subfiles.summary: The sheet identifies one paper filed under “Societies—Formosa; Taiwan.” It records that Brunner at Taihoku sent “FE” a signed copy of the minutes of the North Formosa Peace Memorial Association board meeting, held at the Twututia Foreign Club on August 26, 1941. The indexed communication is dated August 29, 1941, but the underlying minutes are not included in the supplied file text.

interest: Although only an index sheet survives here, it documents the existence, meeting place, and activity of a little-known peace memorial association in colonial Taiwan immediately before the Pacific War. It may help historians trace civic associations, foreign-club networks, and American diplomatic reporting in Japanese-ruled Taiwan. The distinction between the communication date and the board-meeting date is also useful for locating related records or the missing signed minutes.
